candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: Victoria 3 PRODUCTION METHOD (PM) glyph, batch 8 PREVIEW ONLY. ONE high-resolution SQUARE 1:1 PNG, genuine transparent alpha background and openings. A small flat PM pictogram, NOT a realistic image or a technical plan.
Input 1 is ONLY the native PM palette/style sheet. Input 2 is ONLY the approved matte grain and beige/ochre glyph style. Do not copy their subjects, words, panels, UI or layouts. Use their broad strong simple shapes, subtle fine MATTE grain, compact silhouette and YELLOW/BEIGE/OCHRE PRODUCTION colour family.
Style: STRICT FLAT TWO-DIMENSIONAL graphic shapes, one GLOBAL VERTICAL GRAPHIC GRADIENT, pale muted beige at top gently grading to muted darker ochre at bottom. Subtle fine matte grain, discreet dark brown graphic outlines. NO object lighting, shaded volume, bevel, extrusion, relief, 3D, metallic gloss, realistic perspective, cast shadows, realism, painting, detailed machinery or factory scene. Flat solid opaque faces, transparent cutouts. NO frame, backdrop, badge, enclosing circle, border around whole composition, text, number, arrow, label, formula, logo, watermark or decorative gears. No modern controls, electrical lighting or electricity symbol.
Broad components and large openings read at 32px. Generous transparent outer margins. Compact nearly square whole icon. Max TWO main symbols; linked constituent parts of a single apparatus count as that apparatus. No people or extra output items. Every depicted component, including fuel/stone if requested, stays in the same beige/ochre family.
Primary request: COKE-FIRED BLAST FURNACE. A tall tapered masonry furnace silhouette in simple flat front elevation, broad foot, narrower open charging throat at top. A few thick horizontal masonry bands, NOT dozens of bricks. One large low arched working opening at the front; ONE thick short air-blast pipe entering the lower side with a conspicuous elbow. The dominant furnace is one main apparatus; a SMALL GROUP OF TWO OR THREE ANGULAR COKE LUMPS at its foot is the second symbol. Coke is coal-derived porous fuel, not wooden logs: lumps should be blunt angular dark-ochre shapes with ONE broad crack per lump, no fine pores. Furnace distinctly tall and tapered, NOT a domed bread/cement oven, cooking stove, laboratory retort, cylindrical steam boiler or modern steel tower. No scaffolding, ladders, crane, landscape, smoke plumes, glowing lava, separate flame or separate product. Compact furnace/fuel composition.
